description: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it: probes it unpaid, decodes the 402 (v1 body or v2 header), validates network, asset (canonical USDC?), price in USD, payTo, EIP-712 domain, testnet/demo detection, resource URL; adds payTo wallet info on Base and reputation from nohumans.directory (incl. whether its latest real purchase delivered) and 402index. Returns verdict looks_ok / caution / do_not_pay. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.001: /api/x402-check)

body.description: Optional JSON body to send when probing with POST

method.description: HTTP method to probe with (default GET)

url.description: The x402 endpoint URL you are about to pay

name: x402_check
title: Check an x402 endpoint before paying
